profile.headline: Software Engineering Manager at Procore Technologies
profile.summary:
Seasoned startup CTO and software engineer with experience growing teams and products to scale. Specialty includes complex web development architecture, cutting edge technology and R&D, team management and growth, and solving hard problems in innovative ways. 

Technical founder of YouEye, which raised 8m+ in funding and was acquired in 2016. 

Experienced in signal processing, crowd-sourcing, software-based human management systems, research systems, data visualization and processing.

Dog lover, writer, audiophile, nature-lover, and comedian.

positions.title: CTO & Founder
positions.description:
Created a world-class research platform interface, simplifying the problems of UX research using a modular and scalable architecture with AngularJS & Ruby on Rails on AWS.

Built a world class engineering team to accomplish the preceding.

positions.title: Web Systems Engineer
positions.description: Full stack engineer for a geographic data storage/mapping application. Was responsible for creating a charting interface to visualize any dataset with a geographic component.

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.description: Sole technical liason, architect and primary engineer building solutions for Fortune 50 companies with ASP.NET, JavaScript, SQL, and Sharepoint.
